g1-design.title: Runner-contract design gate (reasoning gate, design-it-twice)
g1-design.imperative: REASONING GATE — no crew (crew-waiver reason: the deliverable is a design note and I hold the full context; a crew on a pure design note is shallower, not safer). Run a design-it-twice on the RUNNER CONTRACT: dispatch 3 parallel subagents, each producing one candidate under a distinct named constraint (minimal-interface / max-flexibility / common-caller-first), each deciding: (a) scenario schema, (b) checks-as-plain-scripts vs a DSL, (c) temp-install mechanics, (d) headless-agent launch mechanics, (e) N-of-M defaults. Compare on depth/locality/seam/testability; converge to ONE recommendation (my latitude); record the comparison. Write the frozen contract to .agent-work/issue-106/design/runner-contract.md. The contract MUST also settle three critic-raised requirements: (i) INFRA-FENCE (critic finding 2) — a run that aborts on launch failure / timeout / usage-limit is recorded errored/inconclusive and fenced OUT of the N-of-M pass-rate tally; ONLY a run that completed but failed its process checks counts as fail, so environment flake never fails a good corpus; (ii) CORPUS PROVENANCE (finding 6) — the runner asserts the temp target actually contains the candidate-under-test (marker/content hash) and surfaces the evaluated corpus id in the verdict, so a silent install bug cannot green a corpus never loaded; (iii) N/M MEANING (finding 13) — state plainly what N-of-M buys at the pilot sample size (a regression-vs-variance smoke, NOT a statistical guarantee; honest about small M). Attest c1.

g2-implement.title: Runner core + agent-free unit tests: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF from the g1 contract note. Build scripts/run_skill_eval.py PURE LOGIC test-first (TDD): scenario schema parse/validate, check-execution engine, N-of-M verdict math, temp-install planning, headless argv construction (reuse run_crew.py build_crew_argv form: claude -p '<prompt>' [--model X]), and a --dry-run mode that runs everything EXCEPT the real agent launch. Verdict math MUST implement the infra-fence from the g1 contract (errored/inconclusive runs excluded from the N-of-M tally). All covered by tests/test_run_skill_eval.py — AGENT-FREE, canned fixtures, launches NO agent. The unit layer MUST include (critic findings 3, 14, 2): (a) a KNOWN-BAD canned fixture that the check engine scores FAIL — makes falsification permanent and agent-free, not a skippable manual step; (b) a KNOWN-GOOD fixture scored PASS; (c) an INFRA-ABORT fixture recorded errored/inconclusive and excluded from the tally, distinct from FAIL; (d) a mechanical guard that default pytest collection launches no agent (collection-time assertion, not just a reviewer grep). Dispatch constellation-implementer; integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g5-acceptance.title: Live acceptance + falsification + honest-null (reasoning/ops gate)
g5-acceptance.imperative: REASONING/OPS GATE — no crew (crew-waiver: this is a live-run + evidence-paste operation I drive myself; a crew adds no independent verification a re-run does not). Execute ONE pilot scenario for real through the runner, N-of-M, budget <= ~6 agent-sessions, pilot agents one model tier down. Paste the verdict + process-check outputs. The pasted verdict MUST be the runner command's OWN output (critic finding 12 — command-derived, reproducible from a named command anchor, not hand-narrated). Falsification: a deliberately-broken variant (e.g. temp-install a skill with its spine template removed) MUST fail its process checks. If real headless runs prove infeasible this session (usage limits, CLI auth, flakiness), take the HONEST-NULL path — but the floor is RAISED (critic findings 1, 7): honest-null must include a MOCKED END-TO-END run that drives the live-launch path with a fake subprocess + canned transcript through pass AND fail, so g3's live code and the FAIL path have execution evidence even when real agents are blocked (dry-run alone, which exercises zero process-check semantics, is NOT a sufficient floor). Report the blocked live run with exact failure output for the Admiral to route. Write the outcome to .agent-work/issue-106/acceptance.md and attest c1.
